title: Zr-gallic acid based metal organic compound as adsorbent for extraction of uranium(VI) from nitrate solution: adsorption behaviors and mechanisms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3057-3076
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05880E, Paper

Zr–GA efficiently removes U(VI) from aqueous solution via inner-sphere surface complexation with oxygen-donor sites, exhibiting high selectivity, monolayer adsorption, and chemisorption behavior.
